_note: NEW rings only (existing ones stay in static/data/surface-hotspots.json). Offsets are metres from the patch centre (= site point), lat_offset_m north+, lon_offset_m east+. px,py are in the 2048x2048 tier2-lroc.jpg (x right, y down). r_m is the suggested ring radius for kind=area. position_source says where the position comes from; objects/features/areas follow the operator split (A objects at LROC coordinates, B features/areas, C robotic).

hotspot_annotations.label: LM descent-engine blast zone
